SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
D 3569
5 / 5 / 32

May 5 32.

Dear Sir,

With reference to your letter dated April 23,
1932, asking for the address of a certain Captain Davis,
I have to state that there are in Shanghai several
persons named Davis holding the rank of Captain. I shall
endeavour to ascertain the one of these in whom you
are interested, if you will kindly furnish me with
particulars of his age, present occupation, former
address, religion, associates, etc.

Yours faithfully,

Assistant Commissioner (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police.

E. Field, Esq.,
Gavarin House,
14 Hankow Road,
Kowloon,
Hongkong.

1932年5月5日

1932年5月5日。

先生：

关于阁下1932年4月23日来信，询问某位戴维斯上尉（Captain Davis）的地址一事，本人须说明，在上海有数位姓戴维斯且拥有上尉军衔的人士。若蒙阁下提供其年龄、现职、前住址、宗教、交往人员等详细情况，本人将尽力查明阁下所关注的那一位。

此致
敬礼

警务处处长助理（特别股）
代警务处处长

E. Field 先生，
Gavarin House，
汉口路14号，
九龙，
香港。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. ............
No. B. 3569
Special Branch S.S. Station x
Date 31 / 5 / 32
Date May 3. 19 32.）

Subject (in full) Attached Letter from E. Field.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by J.S.Kn. 0-1.

Regarding attached letter signed by one E. Field seeking
information concerning the whereabouts of a Captain Davis. The
letter is vague as to who and what Captain Davis is or was,
but assuming that he is the proprietor of the now destroyed
Ports Hotel, Woosung either of the following addresses can be
used for communicating with him:-

Arco Club
Rue Bourgeat
French Concession.
or
c/o Mr. W.J. Ward
Manager
Whiteaway, Laidlaw and Co.
30 Nanking Road, Shanghai.

（签名：W.B. Moore D.S.）
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Mr Yau,
Please reply saying there
are several Captains named Davis in
Shanghai and asking for fuller
particulars.
JMS）

主题（全称） 附 E. Field 来信。

由 D.S. Moore 拟写。由 J.S.Kn. 转呈。0-1。

关于附函，该函由一名 E. Field 签署，寻求有关戴维斯上尉下落的信息。信中对于戴维斯上尉是何人、曾任何职表述含糊，但假设其为现已毁于战火的吴淞港口酒店（Ports Hotel, Woosung）的业主，则可通过以下任一地址与其联系：

Arco Club（音译）
布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）
法租界。
或
转交 W.J. Ward 先生
经理
惠罗公司（Whiteaway, Laidlaw and Co.）
上海南京路30号。

（签名：W.B. Moore D.S.）
特别股主管警官。

（批注：Yau 先生，
请回复称上海有数位
名为戴维斯的上尉，并请其
提供更详细的资料。
JMS）
